description: Ministry Of Health - Public statement / Notification for Implementing the Second Sri Lanka  Nursing Council.
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists the names and basic titles of individuals appointed to the Sri Lanka Nursing Council (e.g., "Chairman - W. A. Keerthirathne Podimahattaya, Principal, Kandana Nurses Training College"). It does not describe any detailed portfolio responsibilities, functions, or duties of the council or its members, focusing solely on the personnel appointments.
